sections.name: summary
sections.value: TDD the classifier first (it is the root of the defect and the cheapest thing to get wrong). Guardrails: never git add -A, explicit pathspecs; HARNESS_NO_TELEMETRY=1 timeout 30 git commit --no-verify; invoke the CLI as node harness/cli/bin/harness.js; never link the global harness; fence is this worktree + docs/plans/075-windows-nudge-honesty only.

value.title: TDD the classifier: add named_pipe to Trace2Target and classify it BEFORE the ABSOLUTE_TARGET test. Write the table test FIRST, covering both directions — UNC file stays file, both pipe prefixes become named_pipe — plus drive-rooted, POSIX absolute, relative, keyword and fd forms.

Add the negative/known-bad fixtures per prime: at least one input that SHOULD be refused, and a near-miss pipe-like string that must NOT classify as named_pipe. The point is to prove the classifier REFUSES, not just that it accepts.
telemetry-nudge: handle named_pipe with an honest skip naming transport + platform; assert ZERO renames and ZERO deletes (reuse the containment-guard assertions from plan 074).

harness commit: handle named_pipe without taking the file branch — no trace2 override, no sidecar beside the pipe path, envelope never claims buffering and states attribution was not verified on this platform.

Add the real platform guard in src and make every switch over Trace2Target kind exhaustive so the compiler refuses a future unhandled kind. Prove it: add a temporary kind, show it fails typecheck, revert, and record the exact failure output (the plan-074 F011 acceptance pattern).

Correct the record: fix plan 074s non_goals wording if the guard does not fully satisfy it, and state the Windows position honestly in docs/how/gitai-collector.md. Verify no new dependency and that every new test is CI-safe (no pipe, socket, daemon or network).
